messages:
maya-eng: Quick async check on Q2 OKR milestone (Gaugeboard rollout). Can folks reply with 1) shipped 2) slipped 3) next steps + owner + ETA? Pinged folks who own pieces.

omar-product: 1) Shipped — Gaugeboard v1 (read-only) behind flag; backend batching for metrics; product docs draft.
2) Slipped — Live alerts integration (blocked by SRE infra triage); onboarding UX tweaks (low priority now).
3) Next — I'll finish GA checklist and deploy playbook by Fri EOD; need eng review on alert schema (short PR). @liam-eng @nikhil-data :calendar:

liam-eng: 1) Shipped — infra rollout scripts, smoke tests, throttling config.
2) Slipped — autoscaler tuning and mem-pressure mitigation; root cause looks like memory fragmentation on p3-small nodes when KV cache warms up. Kernel-level tweak + canary needed.
3) Next — Liam to own autoscaler follow-up, pairing with maya-eng tomorrow; ETA Mon EOD for hotfix and canary. PR #4582 assigned to @liam-eng for immediate CR. :construction_worker:

sophia-pm: Noted. Product will defer onboarding tweaks to next sprint so we can focus on alerts + autoscale. Omar — confirm whether alerts need API schema changes or just infra access?

deploy-bot: gaugeboard:v1 deployed to staging by ci/pipeline-64 at 1791119800 :rocket:

maya-eng: Thanks — sounds good. I'll set up a quick SRE triage slot tomorrow 9am PT to unblock alerts. Liam — can you add a short rollback checklist and the canary command examples to PR #4582? Also add a test vector that exercises 2048-token path.

liam-eng: Yep, adding checklist + canary steps now, will tag you in PR. Quick CR ping to @omar-product and @sophia-pm for the schema bits.

omar-product: Will review schema tonight and leave comments. Also tagging @nikhil-data — data team needs to approve the metrics schema change before GA.

nikhil-data: Data ack — we'll review schema by Thu and flag any migration concerns. If there's a breaking sample, call it out in PR.

maya-eng: Cool. Owners summary: Alerts infra + schema -> Omar + Nikhil (blocker), Autoscaler fix -> Liam (engineering hotfix, ETA Mon), GA checklist + docs -> Omar (Fri). I’ll run the SRE triage and confirm rollout windows after the canary.

okrs-bot: Reminder: weekly OKR sync today 4pm PT in #product — bring any unresolved blockers.

liam-eng: One last ask — can product surface a fallback UX copy for when alerts are delayed (so page isn't blank)? small tr-ops.

sophia-pm: On it. I'll drop a short copy PR by EOD and link it here.

maya-eng: Perfect. If no objections, we'll treat the onboarding tweaks as stretch and focus infra -> autoscale -> alerts for this milestone. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
